name: Cider
description: Fermented apple juice — dry to sweet, still or sparkling.

tcm.note: An apple base is cool; the ferment pulls the other way.

ayurveda.note: Madya is ushna whatever fruit it starts from.

histamine.note: Fermented and usually sulphited, with the same DAO problem as any alcohol.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. A standard glass or bottle delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
